name: SCB Open Data MCP
author: ashwinvis
description: Exposes Swedish national statistics from SCB through PxWebApi v2. A dedicated local alternative to the SCB v1 integration in MCP Sweden; no API key is configured.

quality.reason: Source review only; no runtime test or full rubric assessment. Python 3.11+ is required. Select stdio explicitly because the CLI defaults to HTTP; README HTTP URL examples are inconsistent. This is a distinct PxWebApi v2 implementation, overlapping the existing aggregator rather than adding a new data provider.
